testsuite.name: au.com.shiftyjelly.pocketcasts.voicecontrol.upload.account.VoiceSharingAccountOperationsFencingTest

testcase.name: 409 arriving after a newer same-session op is Failure - not a conflict outcome
withdrawal serializes a NULL epoch explicitly - exact decoded key set
422 is terminal - no retry
deletion body carries ONLY the request_id
malformed deletion receipt fails closed - dup keys, trailing junk, wrong schema
401 after the session ended triggers NO credential effect
409 with a malformed projection body applies nothing
a later same-session GET fences an older in-flight operation response
the post-commit notification has NO authority effects - deterministic barrier
disclosure versions with quotes and backslashes are JSON-escaped and retry bodies are byte-identical
401 with the SAME bearer and originating session triggers the credential effect once
401 after a rotation BEFORE the coordinated transaction invalidates NOTHING
401 from a superseded same-session operation invalidates NOTHING - generation-fenced
409 revision conflict is terminal - no retry, projection untouched
409 applies the strictly parsed CURRENT projection under the issued token - no replay
enrollment body carries NO epoch - exact decoded key set
mutation retries retain the ORIGINAL request_id and byte-identical body
deleteData fences its terminal outcome - session ended mid-flight discards the receipt
withdraw 409 conflict is a DISTINCT outcome - never reports success
401 when the bearer has since changed triggers NO credential effect
